title.zh: 卷五十五 志第七: 曆四
title.raw: 卷五十五 志第七: 曆四 Volume 55 Treatises 8: Calendar 4

sentences.zh: ○授時曆經下△步中星第五大都北極，出地四十度太強。

translations.literal: ○ Shoushi Calendar Canon, lower volume △ Procedure for Culminating Stars, fifth. At Dadu, the north pole emerges from the earth forty and a fraction degrees.
translations.idiomatic: From the Shoushi Calendar Canon, lower volume. Section 5: Computing Culminating Stars. At the Great Capital, the north celestial pole stands a little more than forty degrees above the horizon.

sentences.zh: 冬至，去極一百一十五度二十一分七十三秒。

translations.literal: At the winter solstice, polar distance: one hundred fifteen degrees, twenty-one parts, seventy-three seconds.
translations.idiomatic: At the winter solstice, the polar distance is 115° 21′ 73″.

sentences.zh: 夏至，去極六十七度四十一分一十三秒。

translations.literal: At the summer solstice, polar distance: sixty-seven degrees, forty-one parts, thirteen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: At the summer solstice, the polar distance is 67° 41′ 13″.

sentences.zh: 冬至晝，夏至夜，三千八百一十五分九十二秒。

translations.literal: Winter-solstice day, summer-solstice night: three thousand eight hundred fifteen parts, ninety-two seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The length of the winter-solstice day and the corresponding summer-solstice night is 3,815 parts and 92 seconds.

sentences.zh: 夏至晝，冬至夜，六千一百八十四分八秒。

translations.literal: Summer-solstice day, winter-solstice night: six thousand one hundred eighty-four parts, eight seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The length of the summer-solstice day and the corresponding winter-solstice night is 6,184 parts and 8 seconds.

sentences.zh: 昏明，二百五十分。

translations.literal: Twilight: two hundred fifty parts.
translations.idiomatic: Twilight lasts 250 parts.

sentences.zh: 黃道出入赤道內外去極度及半晝夜分

translations.literal: Ecliptic's degrees of entry and exit inside and outside the equator, polar distance, and half day-and-night parts.
translations.idiomatic: Polar distances as the ecliptic crosses inside and outside the equator, together with half day-and-night divisions

sentences.zh: （表略）〉

translations.literal: (table abbreviated)
translations.idiomatic: Table omitted.〉

sentences.zh: 求每日黃道出入赤道內外去極度

translations.literal: To find for each day the ecliptic's degrees inside and outside the equator and polar distance.
translations.idiomatic: To find, for each day, the ecliptic's polar distance as it lies inside or outside the equator

sentences.zh: 置所求日晨前夜半黃道積度，滿半歲周，去之，在象限已下，為初限；

translations.literal: Set the accumulated ecliptic degrees at midnight before dawn on the day sought; when full of half a tropical year circumference, remove it; if below the quadrant limit, this is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: Take the accumulated ecliptic longitude at midnight before dawn on the date in question. Divide by half the tropical year circumference and discard the quotient. If the remainder is below the quadrant limit, it is the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，復減半歲周，余為入末限；

translations.literal: if above, again subtract half a tropical year circumference; the remainder is entry into the final limit;
translations.idiomatic: if it is above that limit, subtract half the tropical year circumference again; the remainder is the entry into the final limit;

sentences.zh: 滿積度，去之，余以其段內外差乘之，百約之，所得，用減內外度，為出入赤道內外度；

translations.literal: when full of accumulated degrees, remove it; with the remainder multiply by that segment's inside-outside difference, reduce by a hundred, and what is obtained is used to subtract from the inside-outside degree, yielding the degrees inside and outside the equator;
translations.idiomatic: divide by the accumulated-degree period and take the remainder. Multiply the remainder by that segment's inside-outside difference, reduce by a factor of one hundred, and subtract the result from the tabulated inside-outside degree to obtain the degrees inside or outside the equator;

sentences.zh: 內減外加象限，即所求去極度及分秒。

translations.literal: inside subtract, outside add the quadrant limit; this is the polar distance sought, with parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: subtract inside the equator and add outside it to the quadrant limit, and the result is the polar distance sought, in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求每日半晝夜及日出入晨昏分

translations.literal: To find for each day the half day-and-night and the day's entry and exit, dawn and dusk parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find, for each day, the half day-and-night division and the parts for sunrise, sunset, dawn, and dusk

sentences.zh: 置所求入初末限，滿積度，去之，余以晝夜差乘之，百約之，所得，加減其段半晝夜分，為所求日半晝夜分；）

translations.literal: Set the entry into initial or final limit for what is sought; when full of accumulated degrees, remove it; with the remainder multiply by the day-night difference, reduce by a hundred, and what is obtained is added or subtracted to that segment's half day-and-night part, yielding the half day-and-night part for the day sought;)
translations.idiomatic: Take the entry into the initial or final limit for the date sought. Divide by the accumulated-degree period and discard the quotient. Multiply the remainder by the day-night difference, reduce by one hundred, and add or subtract the result to that segment's half day-and-night value to obtain the half day-and-night division for the day in question;)

sentences.zh: 前多後少為減，前少後多為加。

translations.literal: If the former is more and the latter less, subtract; if the former is less and the latter more, add.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract when the earlier value is larger and the later smaller; add when the earlier is smaller and the later larger.

sentences.zh: 以半夜分便為日出分，用減日周，余為日入分；

translations.literal: Take the midnight part directly as the sunrise part; subtract from the day circumference; the remainder is the sunset part;
translations.idiomatic: Treat the midnight division directly as the sunrise division. Subtract it from the day circumference; the remainder is the sunset division;

sentences.zh: 以昏明分減日出分，余為晨分；

translations.literal: subtract the twilight part from the sunrise part; the remainder is the dawn part;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the twilight division from the sunrise division; the remainder is the dawn division;

sentences.zh: 加日入分，為昏分。

translations.literal: add to the sunset part to obtain the dusk part.
translations.idiomatic: add the twilight division to the sunset division to obtain the dusk division.

sentences.zh: 求晝夜刻及日出入辰刻

translations.literal: To find the day-and-night ke and the day's entry and exit in double-hour ke.
translations.idiomatic: To find the day-and-night divisions in ke and the double-hour ke of sunrise and sunset

sentences.zh: 置半夜分，倍之，百約，為夜刻；

translations.literal: Set the midnight part, double it, reduce by a hundred, as the night ke;
translations.idiomatic: Take the midnight division, double it, and reduce by one hundred to obtain the night ke;

sentences.zh: 以減百刻，余為晝刻；

translations.literal: subtract from one hundred ke; the remainder is the day ke;
translations.idiomatic: subtract that from one hundred ke; the remainder is the day ke;

sentences.zh: 以日出入分依發斂求之，即得所求辰刻。

translations.literal: Take the day's entry and exit parts and seek them according to the expansion and contraction tables; then one obtains the double-hour ke sought.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the sunrise and sunset divisions according to the expansion-and-contraction procedure to obtain the sought double-hour ke.

sentences.zh: 求更點率置晨分，倍之，五約，為更率；

translations.literal: To find the watch and bell-stroke rates: set the dawn part, double it, reduce by five, as the watch rate;
translations.idiomatic: To find the watch and bell-stroke rates: take the dawn division, double it, and reduce by five to obtain the watch rate;

sentences.zh: 又五約更率，為點率。

translations.literal: again reduce the watch rate by five to obtain the bell-stroke rate.
translations.idiomatic: reduce the watch rate by five again to obtain the bell-stroke rate.

sentences.zh: 求更點所在辰刻

translations.literal: To find the double-hour ke at which each watch and bell-stroke falls.
translations.idiomatic: To find the double-hour ke for each watch and bell-stroke

sentences.zh: 置所求更點數，以更點率乘之，加其日昏分，依發斂求之，即得所求辰刻。

translations.literal: Set the number of watches and bell-strokes sought, multiply by the watch-and-bell rate, add that day's dusk part, seek according to expansion and contraction, and one obtains the double-hour ke sought.
translations.idiomatic: Take the watch or bell-stroke number sought, multiply it by the watch-and-bell rate, add the day's dusk division, and apply the expansion-and-contraction procedure to obtain the corresponding double-hour ke.

sentences.zh: 求距中度及更差度

translations.literal: To find the median-distance degree and the watch-difference degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the median-distance degree and the watch-interval degree

sentences.zh: 置半日周，以其日晨分減之，余為距中分；

translations.literal: Set half the day circumference, subtract that day's dawn part; the remainder is the median-distance part;
translations.idiomatic: Take half the day circumference and subtract that day's dawn division; the remainder is the median-distance division;

sentences.zh: 以三百六十六度二十五分七十五秒乘之，如日周而一，所得，為距中度；

translations.literal: multiply by three hundred sixty-six degrees, twenty-five parts, seventy-five seconds; divide by the day circumference as one; what is obtained is the median-distance degree;
translations.idiomatic: multiply by 366° 25′ 75″, divide by the day circumference, and the quotient is the median-distance in degrees;

sentences.zh: 用減一百八十三度一十二分八十七秒半，倍之，五除，為更差度及分。

translations.literal: use to subtract from one hundred eighty-three degrees, twelve parts, eighty-seven and a half seconds; double it; divide by five; this is the watch-difference degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: subtract that from 183° 12′ 87½″, double the result, and divide by five to obtain the watch-interval in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 求昏明五更中星

translations.literal: To find the culminating stars at dusk, dawn, and the five watches.
translations.idiomatic: To find the culminating stars at dusk, dawn, and each of the five night watches

sentences.zh: 置距中度，以其日午中赤道日度加而命之，即昏中星所臨宿次，命為初更中星；

translations.literal: Set the median-distance degree, add and name with that day's noon median equatorial solar degree; this is the lodge crossed by the dusk culminating star; name it as the first-watch culminating star;
translations.idiomatic: Take the median-distance degree, add the sun's equatorial longitude at noon that day, and assign the lodge; that lodge is where the dusk culminating star stands—take it as the first-watch culminating star;

sentences.zh: 以更差度累加之，滿赤道宿次去之，為逐更及曉中星宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: accumulatively add the watch-difference degree; when full of equatorial lodges remove it; this yields for each watch and for dawn the culminating star's lodge degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: add the watch-interval degree cumulatively for each watch; whenever the sum fills a full circuit of equatorial lodges, discard one circuit. This gives the lodge, degree, and parts for each watch and for dawn.

sentences.zh: 其九服所在晝夜刻分及中星諸率，並準隨處北極出地度數推之。

translations.literal: For the nine domains' locations, the day-and-night ke and parts and all rates for culminating stars are alike calculated by the local north pole's degrees emerging from the earth.
translations.idiomatic: For each of the nine domains, the day-and-night ke, parts, and all culminating-star rates are likewise derived from the local altitude of the north celestial pole.

sentences.zh: （已上諸率，與晷漏所推自相符契。）〉

translations.literal: (The above rates accord on their own with what is derived from the gnomon and clepsydra.)
translations.idiomatic: (The rates above agree of themselves with the results obtained from the gnomon-shadow and water-clock procedures.)

sentences.zh: 求九服所在漏刻

translations.literal: To find the clepsydra ke for the nine domains' locations.
translations.idiomatic: To find the clepsydra divisions for each of the nine domains

sentences.zh: 各於所在以儀測驗，或下水漏，以定其處冬至或夏至夜刻，與五十刻相減，余為至差刻。

translations.literal: At each location verify by instrument, or set up a water clepsydra, to fix that place's winter- or summer-solstice night ke; subtract from fifty ke; the remainder is the solstice-difference ke.
translations.idiomatic: At each locality determine by instrument observation, or by setting up a water clock, the night ke at the winter or summer solstice for that place. Subtract it from fifty ke; the remainder is the solstice-difference ke.

sentences.zh: 置所求日黃道，去赤道內外度及分，以至差刻乘之，進一位，如二百三十九而一，所得內減外加五十刻，即所求夜刻；

translations.literal: Set the ecliptic for the day sought, its degrees inside and outside the equator and parts; multiply by the solstice-difference ke, advance one place, divide as one to two hundred thirty-nine; what is obtained: inside subtract, outside add to fifty ke; this is the night ke sought;
translations.idiomatic: Take the ecliptic's degrees inside or outside the equator for the day sought, multiply by the solstice-difference ke, advance one decimal place, and divide by 239. Subtract the result inside the equator and add it outside, then apply that to fifty ke to obtain the night ke for the date in question;

sentences.zh: 以減百刻，余為晝刻。

translations.literal: subtract from one hundred ke; the remainder is the day ke.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the night ke from one hundred ke; the remainder is the day ke.

sentences.zh: （其日出入辰刻及更點等率，依術求之。）〉

translations.literal: (Its day's entry and exit double-hour ke and watch-and-bell rates and the like are sought according to the procedure.)
translations.idiomatic: (The double-hour ke of sunrise and sunset and the watch-and-bell rates are obtained by the procedures above.)

sentences.zh: △步交會第六交終分，二十七萬二千一百二十二分二十四秒。

translations.literal: △ Procedure for Conjunctions, sixth. Nodal completion parts: two hundred seventy-two thousand one hundred twenty-two parts, twenty-four seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Section 6: Computing Conjunctions. Nodal period in parts: 272,122 parts and 24 seconds.

sentences.zh: 交終，二十七日二千一百二十二分二十四秒。

translations.literal: Nodal completion: twenty-seven days, two thousand one hundred twenty-two parts, twenty-four seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Nodal period: 27 days, 2,122 parts, and 24 seconds.

sentences.zh: 交中，十三日六千六十一分一十二秒。

translations.literal: Nodal median: thirteen days, six thousand sixty-one parts, twelve seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Half nodal period: 13 days, 6,061 parts, and 12 seconds.

sentences.zh: 交差，二日三千一百八十三分六十九秒。

translations.literal: Nodal difference: two days, three thousand one hundred eighty-three parts, sixty-nine seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Nodal inequality: 2 days, 3,183 parts, and 69 seconds.

sentences.zh: 交望，十四日七千六百五十二分九十六秒半。

translations.literal: Nodal full moon: fourteen days, seven thousand six hundred fifty-two parts, ninety-six and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Synodic nodal interval from new moon to full moon: 14 days, 7,652 parts, and 96½ seconds.

sentences.zh: 交應，二十六萬一百八十七分八十六秒。

translations.literal: Nodal epoch: two hundred sixty thousand one hundred eighty-seven parts, eighty-six seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Nodal epoch constant: 260,187 parts and 86 seconds.

sentences.zh: 交終，三百六十三度七十九分三十四秒。

translations.literal: Nodal completion in degrees: three hundred sixty-three degrees, seventy-nine parts, thirty-four seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Nodal period in degrees: 363° 79′ 34″.

sentences.zh: 交中，一百八十一度八十九分六十七秒。

translations.literal: Nodal median: one hundred eighty-one degrees, eighty-nine parts, sixty-seven seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Half nodal period in degrees: 181° 89′ 67″.

sentences.zh: 正交，三百五十七度六十四分。

translations.literal: Primary node: three hundred fifty-seven degrees, sixty-four parts.
translations.idiomatic: Primary node longitude: 357° 64′.

sentences.zh: 中交，一百八十八度五分。

translations.literal: Median node: one hundred eighty-eight degrees, five parts.
translations.idiomatic: Median node longitude: 188° 05′.

sentences.zh: 日食陽歷限，六度。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse, yang limit: six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Solar eclipse limit on the solar side: 6°.

sentences.zh: 定法，六十。

translations.literal: Fixing factor: sixty.
translations.idiomatic: Correction divisor: 60.

sentences.zh: 陰歷限，八度。

translations.literal: Yin limit: eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar-side eclipse limit: 8°.

sentences.zh: 定法，八十。

translations.literal: Fixing factor: eighty.
translations.idiomatic: Correction divisor: 80.

sentences.zh: 月食限，十三度五分。

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse limit: thirteen degrees, five parts.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipse limit: 13° 05′.

sentences.zh: 定法，八十七。

translations.literal: Fixing factor: eighty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: Correction divisor: 87.

sentences.zh: 推天正經朔入交

translations.literal: To derive the Heavenly Standard month's standard new moon's entry into conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: To compute entry into the nodes at the Heavenly Standard month's canonical new moon

sentences.zh: 置中積，加交應，減閏余，滿交終分，去之；

translations.literal: Set the median accumulation, add the nodal epoch, subtract intercalary remainder; when full of nodal completion parts, remove it;
translations.idiomatic: Take the median accumulation, add the nodal epoch constant, and subtract the intercalary remainder. Divide by the nodal period in parts and discard the quotient;

sentences.zh: 不盡，以日周約之為日，不滿為分秒，即天正經朔入交泛日及分秒。）

translations.literal: what is not exhausted, reduce by the day circumference to obtain days; what does not fill is parts and seconds; this is the Heavenly Standard standard new moon's entry into conjunction in general days and parts and seconds.)
translations.idiomatic: convert the remainder by the day circumference into days, with the leftover as parts and seconds. The result is the provisional day, parts, and seconds of nodal entry at the Heavenly Standard canonical new moon.)

sentences.zh: 上考者，中積內加所求閏余，減交應，滿交終去之，不盡，以減交終，余如上。

translations.literal: For upward examination, within the median accumulation add the intercalary remainder sought, subtract the nodal epoch; when full of nodal completion remove it; what is not exhausted, subtract from nodal completion; the remainder is as above.
translations.idiomatic: For retrospective calculation, add the intercalary remainder sought to the median accumulation and subtract the nodal epoch. Divide by the nodal period and discard the quotient; subtract the remainder from one full nodal period and proceed as above.

sentences.zh: 求次朔望入交

translations.literal: To find the next new and full moons' entry into conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: To find nodal entry for successive new and full moons

sentences.zh: 置天正經朔入交泛日及分秒，以交望累加之，滿交終日，去之，即為次朔望入交泛日及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the Heavenly Standard standard new moon's entry into conjunction in general days and parts and seconds; accumulatively add the nodal full-moon interval; when full of nodal completion days remove it; this is the next new and full moons' entry into conjunction in general days and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Take the provisional nodal-entry day, parts, and seconds at the Heavenly Standard new moon and add the nodal synodic interval cumulatively for each subsequent syzygy. Whenever the sum fills a nodal period in days, discard one period. The remainder gives the provisional nodal entry for each following new or full moon.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望及每日夜半入交

translations.literal: To find the fixed new and full moons and each day's midnight entry into conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: To find nodal entry at the fixed new and full moons and at midnight for each day

sentences.zh: 各置入交泛日及分秒，減去經朔望小余，即為定朔望夜半入交。

translations.literal: For each, set the entry into conjunction in general days and parts and seconds, subtract the standard new-or-full moon's small remainder; this is the fixed new or full moon's midnight entry into conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: For each syzygy, take the provisional nodal-entry day, parts, and seconds and subtract the canonical syzygy's small remainder to obtain nodal entry at the fixed syzygy's midnight.

sentences.zh: 若定日有增損者，亦如之。

translations.literal: If the fixed day has increase or decrease, it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed date has been adjusted up or down, apply the same adjustment.

sentences.zh: 否則因經為定，大月加二日，小月加一日，餘皆加七千八百七十七分七十六秒，即次朔夜半入交；

translations.literal: Otherwise take the standard as fixed; for a long month add two days, for a short month add one day; for the remainder always add seven thousand eight hundred seventy-seven parts, seventy-six seconds; this is the next new moon's midnight entry into conjunction;
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise derive the fixed value from the canonical one: add two days after a long month and one day after a short month, and always add 7,877 parts and 76 seconds to the remainder to obtain nodal entry at the next new moon's midnight;

sentences.zh: 累加一日，滿交終日，去之，即每日夜半入交泛日及分秒。

translations.literal: accumulatively add one day; when full of nodal completion days remove it; this is each day's midnight entry into conjunction in general days and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: add one day cumulatively for each following day; whenever the sum fills a nodal period in days, discard one period. This yields the provisional nodal entry at midnight for each day.

sentences.zh: 求定朔望加時入交

translations.literal: To find the fixed new and full moons' entry into conjunction at the hour of occurrence.
translations.idiomatic: To find nodal entry at the true hour of each fixed new or full moon

sentences.zh: 置經朔望入交泛日及分秒，以定朔望加減差加減之，即定朔望加時入交日及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the standard new or full moon's entry into conjunction in general days and parts and seconds; add or subtract by the fixed new-or-full moon's increase-decrease difference; this is the fixed new or full moon's entry into conjunction at the hour of occurrence in days and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Take the canonical syzygy's provisional nodal entry in days, parts, and seconds and add or subtract the fixed syzygy's time-correction difference to obtain nodal entry at the true hour of the fixed syzygy.

sentences.zh: 求交常交定度

translations.literal: To find the regular nodal degree and the fixed nodal degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean and true nodal longitudes

sentences.zh: 置經朔望入交泛日及分秒，以月平行度乘之，為交常度；

translations.literal: Set the standard new or full moon's entry into conjunction in general days and parts and seconds; multiply by the moon's mean motion degree; this is the regular nodal degree;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the canonical syzygy's provisional nodal entry in days, parts, and seconds by the moon's mean daily motion to obtain the mean nodal longitude;

sentences.zh: 以盈縮差盈加縮減之，為交定度。

translations.literal: with the excess-deficiency difference, add if excess and subtract if deficiency; this is the fixed nodal degree.
translations.idiomatic: add the equation-of-center correction when in excess and subtract when in deficiency to obtain the true nodal longitude.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚定分

translations.literal: To find the fixed parts for the greatest moment of solar and lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed time-parts for greatest eclipse of the sun or moon

sentences.zh: 日食：視定朔分在半日周已下，去減半周，為中前；

translations.literal: Solar eclipse: regard the fixed new-moon part; if below half the day circumference, go subtract half the circumference; this is before median;
translations.idiomatic: For a solar eclipse: if the fixed new-moon division is below half the day circumference, subtract it from half the circumference to obtain the pre-noon interval;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去半周，為中後；

translations.literal: if above, subtract half the circumference; this is after median;
translations.idiomatic: if it is above that, subtract half the circumference from it to obtain the post-noon interval;

sentences.zh: 與半周相減、相乘，退二位，如九十六而一，為時差；

translations.literal: mutually subtract and multiply with half the circumference, retreat two places, divide as one to ninety-six; this is the time difference;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the interval from half the circumference and multiply the two quantities, shift two decimal places, and divide by 96 to obtain the time correction;

sentences.zh: 中前以減，中後以加，皆加減定朔分，為食甚定分；

translations.literal: before median subtract, after median add; in each case add or subtract to the fixed new-moon part; this is the fixed part for greatest eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the correction before noon and add it after noon to the fixed new-moon division to obtain the fixed division for greatest eclipse;

sentences.zh: 以中前後分各加時差，為距午定分。

translations.literal: to each of the before- and after-median parts add the time difference; this is the fixed part for distance from noon.
translations.idiomatic: add the time correction to the pre- or post-noon interval respectively to obtain the fixed distance-from-noon division.

sentences.zh: 月食：視定望分在日周四分之一已下，為卯前；

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse: regard the fixed full-moon part; if below one quarter of the day circumference, this is before mao;
translations.idiomatic: For a lunar eclipse: if the fixed full-moon division is below one quarter of the day circumference, it is before mao, in early morning;

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減半周，為卯後；

translations.literal: if above, invert and subtract half the circumference; this is after mao;
translations.idiomatic: if above that but still within the first half of the day, subtract from half the circumference to obtain the interval after mao;

sentences.zh: 在四分之三已下，減去半周，為酉前；

translations.literal: if below three quarters, subtract half the circumference; this is before you;
translations.idiomatic: if below three quarters of the day circumference, subtract half the circumference to obtain the interval before you, in the evening;

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減日周，為酉後。

translations.literal: if above, invert and subtract the day circumference; this is after you.
translations.idiomatic: if above three quarters, subtract from the full day circumference to obtain the interval after you.

sentences.zh: 以卯酉前後分自乘，退二位，如四百七十八而一，為時差；

translations.literal: square the before- or after-mao/you parts, retreat two places, divide as one to four hundred seventy-eight; this is the time difference;
translations.idiomatic: Square the mao- or you-interval, shift two decimal places, and divide by 478 to obtain the time correction;

sentences.zh: 子前以減，子後以加，皆加減定望分，為食甚定分；

translations.literal: before zi subtract, after zi add; in each case add or subtract to the fixed full-moon part; this is the fixed part for greatest eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the correction before zi, at midnight, and add it after zi to the fixed full-moon division to obtain the fixed division for greatest eclipse;

sentences.zh: 各依發斂求之，即食甚辰刻。

translations.literal: for each seek according to expansion and contraction; then one obtains the double-hour ke for greatest eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: apply the expansion-and-contraction procedure to each to obtain the double-hour ke of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚入盈縮歷及日行定度

translations.literal: To find the greatest eclipse's entry into the excess-deficiency sequence and the sun's fixed daily motion degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find, at greatest eclipse, entry into the solar anomaly sequence and the true solar longitude

sentences.zh: 置經朔望入盈縮歷日及分，以食甚日及定分加之，以經朔望日及分減之，即為食甚入盈縮歷；

translations.literal: Set the standard new or full moon's entry into the excess-deficiency sequence in days and parts; add the greatest-eclipse day and fixed parts; subtract the standard new or full moon's day and parts; this is greatest eclipse's entry into the excess-deficiency sequence;
translations.idiomatic: Take the canonical syzygy's entry into the anomaly sequence in days and parts, add the day and fixed parts to greatest eclipse, and subtract the canonical syzygy's day and parts to obtain the anomaly-sequence entry at greatest eclipse;

sentences.zh: 依日躔術求盈縮差，盈加縮減之，為食甚入盈縮歷定度。

translations.literal: according to the solar motion procedure seek the excess-deficiency difference; add if excess, subtract if deficiency; this is greatest eclipse's entry into the excess-deficiency sequence fixed degree.
translations.idiomatic: by the solar-motion procedure find the equation-of-center correction, add it when in excess and subtract when in deficiency, to obtain the true solar longitude at greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求南北差

translations.literal: To find the north-south difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the north-south correction

sentences.zh: 視日食甚入盈縮歷定度，在象限已下，為初限；

translations.literal: Regard the solar eclipse greatest moment's entry into the excess-deficiency sequence fixed degree; if below the quadrant limit, this is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: For a solar eclipse, take the true solar longitude at greatest eclipse; if it is below the quadrant limit, it is the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，用減半歲周，為末限；

translations.literal: if above, use to subtract half a tropical year circumference; this is the final limit;
translations.idiomatic: if above the quadrant limit, subtract from half the tropical year circumference to obtain the final limit;

sentences.zh: 以初末限度自相乘，如一千八百七十而一，為度，不滿，退除為分秒；

translations.literal: multiply the initial or final limit degree by itself, divide as one to one thousand eight hundred seventy; this is degrees; if not full, retreat and divide to obtain parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: square the initial or final limit, divide by 1,870 to obtain degrees, and convert any remainder into parts and seconds;

sentences.zh: 用減四度四十六分，余為南北泛差；

translations.literal: use to subtract four degrees, forty-six parts; the remainder is the general north-south difference;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the result from 4° 46′ to obtain the provisional north-south correction;

sentences.zh: 以距午定分乘之，以半晝分除之，所得，以減泛差，為定差。

translations.literal: multiply by the fixed part for distance from noon, divide by the half-day part; what is obtained is used to subtract from the general difference; this is the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: multiply the provisional correction by the fixed distance-from-noon division and divide by the half-day division; subtract the quotient from the provisional correction to obtain the fixed correction.

sentences.zh: 泛差不及減者，反減之為定差，應加者減之，應減者加之。

translations.literal: If the general difference is insufficient to subtract, inversely subtract to obtain the fixed difference; where one should add, subtract; where one should subtract, add.
translations.idiomatic: If the provisional correction is smaller than the amount to be subtracted, reverse the subtraction to obtain the fixed correction, reversing the sign: add where subtraction was indicated and subtract where addition was indicated.

sentences.zh: 在盈初縮末者，交前陰歷減，陽歷加，交後陰歷加，陽歷減；

translations.literal: When in excess at the initial limit and deficiency at the final limit: before the node, yin limit subtract, yang limit add; after the node, yin limit add, yang limit subtract;
translations.idiomatic: When the sun is in excess at the initial limit and in deficiency at the final limit: before the node subtract on the lunar side and add on the solar side; after the node add on the lunar side and subtract on the solar side;

sentences.zh: 在縮初盈末者，交前陰歷加，陽歷減，交後陰歷減，陽歷加。

translations.literal: When in deficiency at the initial limit and excess at the final limit: before the node, yin limit add, yang limit subtract; after the node, yin limit subtract, yang limit add.
translations.idiomatic: When the sun is in deficiency at the initial limit and in excess at the final limit: before the node add on the lunar side and subtract on the solar side; after the node subtract on the lunar side and add on the solar side.

sentences.zh: 求東西差

translations.literal: To find the east-west difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the east-west correction

sentences.zh: 視日食甚入盈縮歷定度，與半歲周相減相乘，如一千八百七十而一，為度，不滿，退除為分秒，為東西泛差；

translations.literal: Regard the solar eclipse greatest moment's entry into the excess-deficiency sequence fixed degree; mutually subtract and multiply with half a tropical year circumference, divide as one to one thousand eight hundred seventy; this is degrees; if not full, retreat and divide to obtain parts and seconds; this is the general east-west difference;
translations.idiomatic: Take the true solar longitude at greatest solar eclipse, subtract it from half the tropical year circumference and multiply the two quantities, divide by 1,870 to obtain degrees, and convert any remainder into parts and seconds. The result is the provisional east-west correction;

sentences.zh: 以距午定分乘之，以日周四分之一除之，為定差。

translations.literal: multiply by the fixed part for distance from noon, divide by one quarter of the day circumference; this is the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: multiply by the fixed distance-from-noon division and divide by one quarter of the day circumference to obtain the fixed correction.

sentences.zh: 若在泛差已上者，倍泛差減之，余為定差，依其加減。

translations.literal: If above the general difference, double the general difference and subtract it; the remainder is the fixed difference; add or subtract according to it.
translations.idiomatic: If the provisional correction has already been exceeded, double the provisional correction and subtract it; the remainder is the fixed correction, to be added or subtracted accordingly.

sentences.zh: 在盈中前者，交前陰歷減，陽歷加；

translations.literal: When in excess before the median: before the node, yin limit subtract, yang limit add;
translations.idiomatic: When in excess before the median point: before the node subtract on the lunar side and add on the solar side;

sentences.zh: 交後陰歷加，陽歷減；

translations.literal: after the node, yin limit add, yang limit subtract;
translations.idiomatic: after the node add on the lunar side and subtract on the solar side;

sentences.zh: 中後者，交前陰歷加，陽歷減；

translations.literal: after the median: before the node, yin limit add, yang limit subtract;
translations.idiomatic: after the median point: before the node add on the lunar side and subtract on the solar side;

sentences.zh: 交後陰歷減，陽歷加。

translations.literal: after the node, yin limit subtract, yang limit add.
translations.idiomatic: after the node subtract on the lunar side and add on the solar side.

sentences.zh: 在縮中前者，交前陰歷加，陽歷減；

translations.literal: When in deficiency before the median: before the node, yin limit add, yang limit subtract;
translations.idiomatic: When in deficiency before the median point: before the node add on the lunar side and subtract on the solar side;

sentences.zh: 交後陰歷減，陽歷加；

translations.literal: after the node, yin limit subtract, yang limit add;
translations.idiomatic: after the node subtract on the lunar side and add on the solar side;

sentences.zh: 中後者，交前陰歷減，陽歷加；

translations.literal: after the median: before the node, yin limit subtract, yang limit add;
translations.idiomatic: after the median point: before the node subtract on the lunar side and add on the solar side;

sentences.zh: 交後陰歷加，陽歷減。

translations.literal: after the node, yin limit add, yang limit subtract.
translations.idiomatic: after the node add on the lunar side and subtract on the solar side.

sentences.zh: 求日食正交中交限度

translations.literal: To find the solar eclipse primary-node and median-node limit degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the limit degrees for a solar eclipse at the primary and median nodes

sentences.zh: 置正交、中交度，以南北東西差加減之，為正交、中交限度及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the primary-node and median-node degrees; add or subtract by the north-south and east-west differences; this is the primary-node and median-node limit degrees and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Take the primary-node and median-node longitudes, add or subtract the north-south and east-west corrections, and obtain the limit degrees, parts, and seconds for the primary and median nodes.

sentences.zh: 求日食入陰陽歷去交前後度

translations.literal: To find the solar eclipse's entry into yin and yang sequences and degrees before and after the node.
translations.idiomatic: To find, for a solar eclipse, entry into the solar or lunar side and the degrees before or after the node

sentences.zh: 視交定度，在中交限已下，以減中交限，為陽歷交前度；

translations.literal: Regard the fixed nodal degree; if below the median-node limit, subtract from the median-node limit; this is the yang-sequence degrees before the node;
translations.idiomatic: Take the true nodal longitude; if it is below the median-node limit, subtract it from that limit to obtain the solar-side degrees before the node;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去中交限，為陰歷交後度；

translations.literal: if above, subtract the median-node limit; this is the yin-sequence degrees after the node;
translations.idiomatic: if above the limit, subtract the median-node limit to obtain the lunar-side degrees after the node;

sentences.zh: 在正交限已下，以減正交限，為陰歷交前度；

translations.literal: if below the primary-node limit, subtract from the primary-node limit; this is the yin-sequence degrees before the node;
translations.idiomatic: if below the primary-node limit, subtract from that limit to obtain the lunar-side degrees before the node;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去正交限，為陽歷交後度。

translations.literal: if above, subtract the primary-node limit; this is the yang-sequence degrees after the node.
translations.idiomatic: if above the primary-node limit, subtract that limit to obtain the solar-side degrees after the node.

sentences.zh: 求月食入陰陽歷去交前後度

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse's entry into yin and yang sequences and degrees before and after the node.
translations.idiomatic: To find, for a lunar eclipse, entry into the solar or lunar side and the degrees before or after the node

sentences.zh: 視交定度，在交中度已下，為陽歷；

translations.literal: Regard the fixed nodal degree; if below the median-node degree, this is the yang sequence;
translations.idiomatic: Take the true nodal longitude; if it is below the median-node degree, it is on the solar side;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去交中，為陰歷。

translations.literal: if above, subtract the nodal median; this is the yin sequence.
translations.idiomatic: if above the median-node degree, subtract the nodal median to obtain the lunar side.

sentences.zh: 視入陰陽歷，在後準十五度半已下，為交後度；

translations.literal: Regard entry into yin and yang sequences; if below the rear standard of fifteen and a half degrees, this is degrees after the node;
translations.idiomatic: For entry into the solar or lunar side, if below the rear standard of 15°30′, it is after the node;

sentences.zh: 前準一百六十六度三十九分六十八秒已上，覆減交中，余為交前度及分。

translations.literal: if above the front standard of one hundred sixty-six degrees, thirty-nine parts, sixty-eight seconds, invert and subtract the nodal median; the remainder is degrees before the node and parts.
translations.idiomatic: if above the front standard of 166°39′68″, subtract from the nodal median to obtain the degrees and parts before the node.

sentences.zh: 求日食分秒

translations.literal: To find the solar eclipse parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the magnitude of a solar eclipse in parts and seconds

sentences.zh: 視去交前後度，各減陰陽歷食限，

translations.literal: Regard the degrees before and after the node; for each subtract the yin-yang sequence eclipse limit,
translations.idiomatic: Take the degrees before or after the node and subtract the eclipse limit for the solar or lunar side,

sentences.zh: （不及減者不食。）〉

translations.literal: (If insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.)
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder is insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.〉

sentences.zh: 余如定法而一，各為日食之分秒。

translations.literal: the remainder, divide as one to the fixing factor; for each this is the solar eclipse parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: divide each remainder by the correction divisor to obtain the parts and seconds of the solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求月食分秒

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the magnitude of a lunar eclipse in parts and seconds

sentences.zh: 視去交前後度，）

translations.literal: Regard the degrees before and after the node,)
translations.idiomatic: Take the degrees before or after the node,)

sentences.zh: 不用南北東西差者。

translations.literal: do not use the north-south and east-west differences.
translations.idiomatic: without applying the north-south or east-west corrections.

sentences.zh: 用減食限，

translations.literal: Use to subtract the eclipse limit,
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the eclipse limit,

sentences.zh: （不及減者不食。）〉

translations.literal: (If insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.)
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder is insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.〉

sentences.zh: 余如定法而一，為月食之分秒。

translations.literal: the remainder, divide as one to the fixing factor; this is the lunar eclipse parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: divide the remainder by the correction divisor to obtain the parts and seconds of the lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求日食定用及三限辰刻

translations.literal: To find the solar eclipse fixed duration and the three limits in double-hour ke.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed duration of a solar eclipse and the three contact times in double-hour ke

sentences.zh: 置日食分秒，與二十分相減、相乘，平方開之，所得，以五千七百四十乘之，如入定限行度而一，為定用分；

translations.literal: Set the solar eclipse parts and seconds; mutually subtract and multiply with twenty parts; extract the square root; what is obtained, multiply by five thousand seven hundred forty, divide as one to the limit-entry motion degree; this is the fixed-duration part;
translations.idiomatic: Take the parts and seconds of the solar eclipse, subtract them from twenty parts and multiply the two quantities, extract the square root, multiply by 5,740, and divide by the limit-entry motion in degrees to obtain the fixed-duration division;

sentences.zh: 以減食甚定分，為初虧；

translations.literal: subtract from the fixed part for greatest eclipse; this is first contact;
translations.idiomatic: subtract from the fixed division at greatest eclipse to obtain first contact;

sentences.zh: 加食甚定分，為復圓；

translations.literal: add to the fixed part for greatest eclipse; this is restoration of roundness;
translations.idiomatic: add to the fixed division at greatest eclipse to obtain last contact;

sentences.zh: 依發斂求之，為日食三限辰刻。

translations.literal: Seek according to expansion and contraction; this is the solar eclipse's three limits in double-hour ke.
translations.idiomatic: apply the expansion-and-contraction procedure to obtain the three contact times of the solar eclipse in double-hour ke.

sentences.zh: 求月食定用及三限五限辰刻

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse fixed duration and the three and five limits in double-hour ke.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed duration of a lunar eclipse and the three or five contact times in double-hour ke

sentences.zh: 置月食分秒，與三十分相減、相乘，平方開之；

translations.literal: Set the lunar eclipse parts and seconds; mutually subtract and multiply with thirty parts; extract the square root;
translations.idiomatic: Take the parts and seconds of the lunar eclipse, subtract them from thirty parts and multiply the two quantities, and extract the square root;

sentences.zh: 所得，以五千七百四十乘之，如入定限行度而一，為定用分；

translations.literal: what is obtained, multiply by five thousand seven hundred forty, divide as one to the limit-entry motion degree; this is the fixed-duration part;
translations.idiomatic: multiply the result by 5,740 and divide by the limit-entry motion in degrees to obtain the fixed-duration division;

sentences.zh: 以減食甚定分，為初虧；

translations.literal: subtract from the fixed part for greatest eclipse; this is first contact;
translations.idiomatic: subtract from the fixed division at greatest eclipse to obtain first contact;

sentences.zh: 加食甚定分，為復圓；

translations.literal: add to the fixed part for greatest eclipse; this is restoration of roundness;
translations.idiomatic: add to the fixed division at greatest eclipse to obtain last contact;

sentences.zh: 依發斂求之，即月食三限辰刻。

translations.literal: Seek according to expansion and contraction; then one has the lunar eclipse's three limits in double-hour ke.
translations.idiomatic: apply the expansion-and-contraction procedure to obtain the three contact times of the lunar eclipse in double-hour ke.

sentences.zh: 月食既者，以既內分與一十分相減、相乘，平方開之，所得，以五千七百四十乘之，如入定限行度而一，為既內分；

translations.literal: For a total lunar eclipse, mutually subtract and multiply the within-totality part with ten parts; extract the square root; what is obtained, multiply by five thousand seven hundred forty, divide as one to the limit-entry motion degree; this is the within-totality part;
translations.idiomatic: For a total lunar eclipse, subtract the within-totality division from ten parts and multiply the two quantities, extract the square root, multiply by 5,740, and divide by the limit-entry motion in degrees to obtain the within-totality division;

sentences.zh: 用減定用分，為既外分；

translations.literal: use to subtract from the fixed-duration part; this is the outside-totality part;
translations.idiomatic: subtract that from the fixed-duration division to obtain the outside-totality division;

sentences.zh: 以定用分減食甚定分，為初虧；

translations.literal: subtract the fixed-duration part from the fixed part for greatest eclipse; this is first contact;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the fixed-duration division from the fixed division at greatest eclipse to obtain first contact;

sentences.zh: 加既外，為食既；

translations.literal: add the outside-totality part; this is totality onset;
translations.idiomatic: add the outside-totality division to obtain the onset of totality;

sentences.zh: 又加既內，為食甚；

translations.literal: again add the within-totality part; this is greatest eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: add the within-totality division again to obtain greatest eclipse;

sentences.zh: 再加既內，為生光；

translations.literal: again add the within-totality part; this is emergence of light;
translations.idiomatic: add the within-totality division once more to obtain emergence from totality;

sentences.zh: 復加既外，為復圓；

translations.literal: again add the outside-totality part; this is restoration of roundness;
translations.idiomatic: add the outside-totality division again to obtain last contact;

sentences.zh: 依發斂求之，即月食五限辰刻。

translations.literal: Seek according to expansion and contraction; then one has the lunar eclipse's five limits in double-hour ke.
translations.idiomatic: apply the expansion-and-contraction procedure to obtain the five contact times of the lunar eclipse in double-hour ke.

sentences.zh: 求月食入更點

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse's entry into watches and bell-strokes.
translations.idiomatic: To find which night watch and bell-stroke a lunar eclipse falls in

sentences.zh: 置食甚所入日晨分，倍之，五約，為更法；

translations.literal: Set the dawn part of the day on which greatest eclipse falls; double it, reduce by five; this is the watch divisor;
translations.idiomatic: Take the dawn division of the day on which greatest eclipse occurs, double it, and reduce by five to obtain the watch divisor;

sentences.zh: 又五約更法，為點法。

translations.literal: again reduce the watch divisor by five; this is the bell-stroke divisor.
translations.idiomatic: reduce the watch divisor by five again to obtain the bell-stroke divisor.

sentences.zh: 乃置初末諸分，昏分已上，減去昏分，晨分已下，加晨分，以更法除之，為更數；

translations.literal: Then set the initial and final various parts; if above the dusk part, subtract the dusk part; if below the dawn part, add the dawn part; divide by the watch divisor; this is the number of watches;
translations.idiomatic: Then take the initial and final divisions: if above the dusk division, subtract the dusk division; if below the dawn division, add the dawn division. Divide by the watch divisor to obtain the watch number;

sentences.zh: 不滿，以點法收之，為點數；

translations.literal: what does not fill, collect by the bell-stroke divisor; this is the number of bell-strokes;
translations.idiomatic: convert any remainder by the bell-stroke divisor to obtain the bell-stroke number;

sentences.zh: 其更點數，命初更初點算外，各得所入更點。

translations.literal: For the watch and bell-stroke numbers, name from outside the count of the first watch and first bell-stroke; for each one obtains the watch and bell-stroke entered.
translations.idiomatic: Assign the watch and bell-stroke numbers starting from the first watch and first bell-stroke outside the count to determine which watch and bell-stroke each contact falls in.

sentences.zh: 求日食所起

translations.literal: To find where the solar eclipse begins.
translations.idiomatic: To find the direction in which a solar eclipse begins

sentences.zh: 食在陽歷，初起西南，甚於正南，復於東南；

translations.literal: If the eclipse is in the yang sequence, it first appears in the southwest, reaches maximum due south, and restores in the southeast;
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse is on the solar side, it first appears in the southwest, reaches maximum due south, and ends in the southeast;

sentences.zh: 食在陰歷，初起西北，甚於正北，復於東北；

translations.literal: if in the yin sequence, it first appears in the northwest, reaches maximum due north, and restores in the northeast;
translations.idiomatic: if on the lunar side, it first appears in the northwest, reaches maximum due north, and ends in the northeast;

sentences.zh: 食八分已上，初起正西，復於正東。

translations.literal: if the eclipse is eight-tenths or more, it first appears due west and restores due east.
translations.idiomatic: if the eclipse magnitude is eight-tenths or greater, it begins due west and ends due east.

sentences.zh: （此據午地而論之。）〉

translations.literal: (This is discussed with reference to the noon meridian.)
translations.idiomatic: This is stated with reference to the noon meridian.〉

sentences.zh: 求月食所起

translations.literal: To find where the lunar eclipse begins.
translations.idiomatic: To find the direction in which a lunar eclipse begins

sentences.zh: 食在陽歷，初起東北，甚於正北，復於西北；

translations.literal: If the eclipse is in the yang sequence, it first appears in the northeast, reaches maximum due north, and restores in the northwest;
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse is on the solar side, it first appears in the northeast, reaches maximum due north, and ends in the northwest;

sentences.zh: 食在陰歷，初起東南，甚於正南，復於西南；

translations.literal: if in the yin sequence, it first appears in the southeast, reaches maximum due south, and restores in the southwest;
translations.idiomatic: if on the lunar side, it first appears in the southeast, reaches maximum due south, and ends in the southwest;

sentences.zh: 食八分已上，初起正東，復於正西。

translations.literal: if the eclipse is eight-tenths or more, it first appears due east and restores due west.
translations.idiomatic: if the eclipse magnitude is eight-tenths or greater, it begins due east and ends due west.

sentences.zh: （此亦據午地而論之。）〉

translations.literal: (This too is discussed with reference to the noon meridian.)
translations.idiomatic: This too is stated with reference to the noon meridian.〉

sentences.zh: 求日月出入帶食所見分數

translations.literal: To find the parts and fractions seen when the sun or moon rises or sets with an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 視其日日出入分，在初虧已上、食甚已下者，為帶食。

translations.idiomatic: multiply by the eclipse magnitude and divide by the fixed-duration division,

translations.literal: (For a total lunar eclipse, subtract the within-totality part from the eclipse-at-rising-or-setting difference; advance the remainder one place, divide as one to the outside-totality part; what is obtained is used to subtract from the totality part; this is the parts seen when the moon rises or sets with eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: For a total lunar eclipse, subtract the within-totality division from the rising-or-setting difference, advance the remainder one decimal place, and divide by the outside-totality division. Subtract the quotient from the totality division to obtain the magnitude seen when the moon rises or sets in eclipse;

sentences.zh: 不及減者，為帶食既出入。）〉

translations.literal: (if insufficient to subtract, this is totality at rising or setting with eclipse.)

sentences.zh: 以減所食分，即日月出入帶食所見之分。

translations.literal: subtract from the parts eclipsed; this is the parts seen when the sun or moon rises or sets with eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以諸段限度累加之，即諸段入歷。

translations.idiomatic: Add the phase limits successively to obtain each phase's entry into the epicycle.

sentences.zh: 求盈縮差

translations.literal: To find the excess-deficiency difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the excess-deficiency correction.

sentences.zh: 置入歷度及分秒，在歷中已下，為盈；

translations.literal: Set the entry into sequence in degrees and parts and seconds; if at or below the sequence median, it is excess;
translations.idiomatic: Take the entry into the epicycle in degrees and parts; if it is at or below half the epicycle, the motion is in excess;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去歷中，余為縮。

translations.literal: If above, subtract the sequence median; the remainder is deficiency.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract half the epicycle; the remainder is the deficiency arc.

sentences.zh: 視盈縮歷，在九十一度三十一分四十三秒太已下，為初限；

translations.literal: If above, use to subtract the sequence median; the remainder is the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract from half the epicycle; the remainder is the final limit.
