translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract from half the epicycle; the remainder is the final limit.

sentences.zh: 縮歷在一百二十一度七十五分二十五秒已下，為初限；

translations.literal: If the deficiency sequence is at or below one hundred twenty-one degrees, seventy-five parts, twenty-five seconds, this is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: On the deficiency arc, if at or below 121° 75′ 25″, this is the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，用減歷中，餘為末限。

translations.literal: If above, use to subtract the sequence median; the remainder is the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract from half the epicycle; the remainder is the final limit.

sentences.zh: 置各星立差，以初末限乘之，去加減平差，得，又以初末限乘之，去加減定差，再以初末限乘之，滿億為度，不滿退除為分秒，即所求盈縮差。

translations.literal: Set each planet's established difference, multiply by the initial or final limit, to add or subtract the mean difference—what is obtained; again multiply by the initial or final limit, to add or subtract the fixed difference; again multiply by the initial or final limit; when full of one hundred million it becomes degrees; what does not fill, retreat and remove as parts and seconds; this is the excess-deficiency difference sought.
translations.idiomatic: Take each planet's established difference, multiply by the initial or final limit, and use the result to add or subtract the mean difference; repeat with the fixed difference; multiply again by the initial or final limit, divide by 100 million to obtain degrees and parts, and the result is the excess-deficiency correction sought.

sentences.zh: 又術：置盈縮歷，以歷策除之，為策數，不盡為策余；

translations.literal: Another procedure: set the excess-deficiency sequence, divide by the sequence stride; this is the stride number; what is not exhausted is the stride remainder;
translations.idiomatic: Alternate method: take the position on the excess-deficiency epicycle, divide by the sequence stride to get the stride count and remainder;

sentences.zh: 以其下損益率乘之，歷策除之，所得，益加損減其下盈縮積，亦為所求盈縮差。

translations.literal: Multiply by the diminish-increase rate below it, divide by the sequence stride; what is obtained, increase by adding or decrease by subtracting to the excess-deficiency accumulation below it; this likewise serves as the excess-deficiency difference sought.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the remainder by the tabulated rate for that stride, divide by the sequence stride, and add or subtract from the accumulated correction at the lower stride to obtain the same excess-deficiency correction.

sentences.zh: 求平合諸段定積

translations.literal: To find the mean conjunction and each phase's fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true accumulation for mean conjunction and for each phase.

sentences.zh: 各置其星其段中積，以其盈縮差盈加縮減之，即其段定積日及分秒；

translations.literal: For each, set that planet's phase median accumulation, with its excess-deficiency difference add if excess and subtract if deficiency; this is that phase's fixed accumulation in days and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: For each planet and phase, take the median accumulation and apply the excess-deficiency correction—adding if in excess, subtracting if in deficiency—to obtain the true accumulation in days and parts;

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至日分加之，滿紀法去之，不滿，命甲子算外，即得日辰。

translations.literal: Add the Heavenly Standard winter solstice day and parts; when full of the era divisor remove it; what does not fill, name outside the jiazi count; one then obtains the day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Add the Heavenly Standard winter solstice date and time, reduce modulo the era divisor, and assign the day and hour from the sexagenary cycle.

sentences.zh: 求平合及諸段所在月日

translations.literal: To find the month and day of mean conjunction and each phase's location.
translations.idiomatic: To find the month and day on which mean conjunction and each phase occur.

sentences.zh: 各置其段定積，以天正閏日及分加之，滿朔策，除之為月數，不盡，為入月已來日數及分秒。

translations.literal: For each, set that phase's fixed accumulation, add the Heavenly Standard intercalary day and parts; when full of the new-moon stride, divide to obtain month count; what is not exhausted is the elapsed days and parts and seconds within the month.
translations.idiomatic: Take the true accumulation for each phase, add the intercalary offset from the Heavenly Standard new year, divide by the new-moon stride to get the month count and the elapsed days within the month.

sentences.zh: 其月數，命天正十一月算外，即其段入月經朔日數及分秒；

translations.literal: For the month count, name outside Heavenly Standard eleventh month; this is that phase's days and parts and seconds elapsed within the month from conjunction;
translations.idiomatic: Count months forward from the Heavenly Standard eleventh month to obtain the days and parts within the month since the new moon for that phase;

sentences.zh: 以日辰相距，為所在定朔月日。

translations.literal: Take the day and double-hour distance; this is the fixed new-moon month and day of location.
translations.idiomatic: Combine with the assigned day and hour to obtain the calendar month and day of occurrence.

sentences.zh: 求平合及諸段加時定星

translations.literal: To find the fixed star at the hour of occurrence for mean conjunction and each phase.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true planetary longitude at the hour of mean conjunction and for each phase.

sentences.zh: 各置其段中星，以盈縮差盈加縮減之，

translations.literal: For each, set that phase's median star; with the excess-deficiency difference, add if in excess and subtract if in deficiency,
translations.idiomatic: For each phase, take the median star and apply the excess-deficiency correction—adding when in excess and subtracting when in deficiency—

sentences.zh: （金星倍之，水星三之。）〉

translations.literal: (For Venus, double it; for Mercury, triple it.)
translations.idiomatic: (Double the correction for Venus; triple it for Mercury.)

sentences.zh: 即諸段定星；

translations.literal: this is each phase's fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: to obtain the true star for every phase;

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即其星其段加時所在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add the Heavenly Standard winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at the hour of occurrence and name by it; one then obtains that planet's phase lodge-degree and parts and seconds at the hour of occurrence.
translations.idiomatic: Add the Heavenly Standard winter solstice ecliptic longitude at the hour of occurrence and assign the lodge position; the result is that planet's ecliptic lodge-degree and parts at the hour of that phase.

sentences.zh: 求諸段初日晨前夜半定星

translations.literal: To find each phase's first-day midnight-before-dawn fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true planetary longitude at midnight before dawn on the first day of each phase.

sentences.zh: 各以其段初行率，乘其段加時分，百約之，乃順減退加其日加時定星，即其段初日晨前夜半定星；

translations.literal: For each, take that phase's initial motion rate, multiply by that phase's hour-of-occurrence parts, reduce by a hundred, then for prograde subtract and for retrograde add to that day's hour-of-occurrence fixed star; this is that phase's first-day midnight-before-dawn fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: For each phase, multiply the initial motion rate by the fractional hour of occurrence, divide by one hundred, then subtract for prograde motion or add for retrograde motion from that day's true longitude at the hour of occurrence; the result is the true longitude at midnight before dawn on the first day of the phase;

sentences.zh: 加命如前，即得所求。

translations.literal: Add and name as before; one then obtains what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Add and assign the lodge position as before to obtain the value sought.

sentences.zh: 求諸段日率度率

translations.literal: To find each phase's day rate and degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: To find the day rate and degree rate for each phase.

sentences.zh: 各以其段日辰距後段日辰為日率，以其段夜半宿次與後段夜半宿次相減，余為度率。

translations.literal: For each, take that phase's day-and-double-hour distance to the next phase's day and double-hour as the day rate; subtract that phase's midnight lodge position from the next phase's midnight lodge position; the remainder is the degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: For each phase, take the elapsed days and hours to the next phase as the day rate, and the difference between midnight lodge positions of the two phases as the degree rate.

sentences.zh: 求諸段平行分各置其段度率，以其段日率除之，即其段平行度及分秒。

translations.literal: To find each phase's uniform motion parts: for each, set that phase's degree rate and divide by that phase's day rate; this is that phase's uniform-motion degrees and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the uniform daily motion for each phase, divide the degree rate by the day rate to obtain the mean daily motion in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 求諸段增減差及日差

translations.literal: To find each phase's increase-decrease difference and day difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the variation correction and daily increment for each phase.

sentences.zh: 以本段前後平行分相減，為其段泛差；

translations.literal: Subtract the uniform motion parts before and after this phase; this is that phase's general difference;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the uniform motion rates at the boundaries of the phase; the result is the phase's general difference;

sentences.zh: 倍而退位，為增減差；

translations.literal: Double it and shift back one place; this is the increase-decrease difference;
translations.idiomatic: Double the result and shift the decimal place; this is the variation correction;

sentences.zh: 以加減其段平行分，為初末日行分。）

translations.literal: Use it to add or subtract to that phase's uniform motion parts; this is the first and last day's motion parts.)
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract it from the phase's uniform motion rate to obtain the daily motion on the first and last days.)

sentences.zh: 前多後少者，加為初，減為末；

translations.literal: When the front is more and the rear less, add for the initial and subtract for the final;
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate exceeds the later, add the correction at the start and subtract at the end;

sentences.zh: 前少後多者，減為初，加為末。

translations.literal: When the front is less and the rear more, subtract for the initial and add for the final.
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate is less than the later, subtract at the start and add at the end.

sentences.zh: 倍增減差，為總差；

translations.literal: Double the increase-decrease difference; this is the total difference;
translations.idiomatic: Double the variation correction to obtain the total difference;

sentences.zh: 以日率減一，除之，為日差。

translations.literal: Divide by the day rate minus one; this is the day difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the day rate minus one to obtain the daily increment.

sentences.zh: 求前後伏遲退段增減差前伏者，置後段初日行分，加其日差之半，為末日行分。

translations.literal: To find the increase-decrease difference for phases of stationary hidden before and after, slow motion, and retrograde: for prior stationary hidden, set the next phase's first-day motion parts, add half its day difference; this is the last day's motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the variation correction for stationary-hidden, slow, and retrograde phases: for a prior stationary-hidden phase, take the next phase's first-day motion rate, add half the daily increment, and the result is the last day's motion rate.

sentences.zh: 後伏者，置前段末日行分，加其日差之半，為初日行分；

translations.literal: For later stationary hidden, set the prior phase's last-day motion parts, add half its day difference; this is the first day's motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: For a later stationary-hidden phase, take the prior phase's last-day motion rate, add half the daily increment, and the result is the first day's motion rate;

sentences.zh: 以減伏段平行分，余為增減差。

translations.literal: Subtract from the stationary-hidden phase's uniform motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the stationary-hidden phase's uniform motion rate; the remainder is the variation correction.

sentences.zh: 前遲者，置前段末日行分，倍其日差，減之，為初日行分。

translations.literal: For prior slow motion, set the prior phase's last-day motion parts, double its day difference and subtract; this is the first day's motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For a prior slow-motion phase, take the prior phase's last-day motion rate, subtract twice the daily increment, and the result is the first day's motion rate.

sentences.zh: 後遲者，置後段初日行分，倍其日差，減之，為末日行分；

translations.literal: For later slow motion, set the next phase's first-day motion parts, double its day difference and subtract; this is the last day's motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: For a later slow-motion phase, take the next phase's first-day motion rate, subtract twice the daily increment, and the result is the last day's motion rate;

sentences.zh: 以遲段平行分減之，余為增減差。）

translations.literal: Subtract from the slow-motion phase's uniform motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.)
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the slow-motion phase's uniform motion rate; the remainder is the variation correction.)

sentences.zh: 前後近留之遲段。

translations.literal: Slow-motion phases near station before and after.
translations.idiomatic: This applies to slow-motion segments adjacent to a station.

sentences.zh: 木火土三星，退行者，六因平行分，退一位，為增減差。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn in retrograde motion, multiply the uniform motion parts by six and shift back one place; this is the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn in retrograde, multiply the uniform motion rate by six and shift the decimal place; the result is the variation correction.

sentences.zh: 金星，前後退伏者，三因平行分，半而退位，為增減差。

translations.literal: For Venus, for retrograde stationary hidden before and after, multiply the uniform motion parts by three, halve and shift back one place; this is the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus in retrograde stationary-hidden phases before and after, multiply the uniform motion rate by three, halve, and shift the decimal place to obtain the variation correction.

sentences.zh: 前退者，置後段初日行分，以其日差減之，為末日行分。

translations.literal: For prior retrograde, set the next phase's first-day motion parts, subtract its day difference; this is the last day's motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For a prior retrograde phase, take the next phase's first-day motion rate, subtract the daily increment, and the result is the last day's motion rate.

sentences.zh: 後退者，置前段末日行分，以其日差減之，為初日行分；

translations.literal: For later retrograde, set the prior phase's last-day motion parts, subtract its day difference; this is the first day's motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: For a later retrograde phase, take the prior phase's last-day motion rate, subtract the daily increment, and the result is the first day's motion rate;

sentences.zh: 乃以本段平行分減之，余為增減差。

translations.literal: Then subtract from this phase's uniform motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract this from the phase's uniform motion rate; the remainder is the variation correction.

sentences.zh: 水星，退行者，半平行分，為增減差；

translations.literal: For Mercury in retrograde motion, take half the uniform motion parts as the increase-decrease difference;
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury in retrograde, take half the uniform motion rate as the variation correction;

sentences.zh: 皆以增減差加減平行分，為初末日行分。

translations.literal: In every case add or subtract the increase-decrease difference to the uniform motion parts to obtain the first and last day's motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: In every case, add or subtract the variation correction from the uniform motion rate to obtain the daily motion on the first and last days.

sentences.zh: 前多後少者，加為初，減為末；

translations.literal: When the front is more and the rear less, add for the initial and subtract for the final;
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate exceeds the later, add the correction at the start and subtract at the end;

sentences.zh: 前少後多者，減為初，加為末。

translations.literal: When the front is less and the rear more, subtract for the initial and add for the final.
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier rate is less than the later, subtract at the start and add at the end.

sentences.zh: 又倍增減差，為總差；

translations.literal: Again double the increase-decrease difference; this is the total difference;
translations.idiomatic: Again double the variation correction to obtain the total difference;

sentences.zh: 以日率減一，除之，為日差。

translations.literal: Divide by the day rate minus one; this is the day difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the day rate minus one to obtain the daily increment.

sentences.zh: 求每日晨前夜半星行宿次

translations.literal: To find daily midnight-before-dawn star motion lodge positions.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's planetary lodge position at midnight before dawn.

sentences.zh: 各置其段初日行分，以日差累損益之，後少則損之，後多則益之，為每日行度及分秒；

translations.literal: For each, set that phase's first-day motion parts and cumulatively adjust by the day difference—subtract if the rear is less, add if the rear is more—to obtain each day's motion in degrees and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: For each phase, start from the first-day motion rate and adjust cumulatively by the daily increment—subtracting when the later rate is smaller, adding when it is larger—to obtain each day's motion in degrees and parts;

sentences.zh: 乃順加退減，滿宿次去之，即每日晨前夜半星行宿次。

translations.literal: Then for prograde add and for retrograde subtract; when full of a lodge span remove it; this is each day's midnight-before-dawn star motion lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: Then add for prograde motion and subtract for retrograde, removing one lodge span whenever the sum is full; the result is the planetary lodge position at midnight before dawn for each day.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合見伏入盈縮歷

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction, appearance-and-stationary-hidden entry into the excess-deficiency sequence.
translations.idiomatic: To find entry into the excess-deficiency epicycle for each planet's mean conjunction, appearance, and stationary-hidden phases.

sentences.zh: 置其星其段定積日及分秒，

translations.literal: Set that planet's phase fixed accumulation in days and parts and seconds,
translations.idiomatic: Take the true accumulation in days and parts for that planet and phase,

sentences.zh: （若滿歲周日及分秒，去之，余在次年天正冬至後。）〉

translations.literal: (If full of the tropical year circumference in days and parts and seconds, remove it; the remainder lies after the next year's Heavenly Standard winter solstice.)
translations.idiomatic: (If the value fills a full tropical year in days and parts, discard one year; the remainder falls after the next year's Heavenly Standard winter solstice.)

sentences.zh: 如在半歲周已下，為入盈歷；

translations.literal: If at or below half a tropical year circumference, this is entry into the excess sequence;
translations.idiomatic: If it is at or below half a tropical year, the planet is on the excess arc;

sentences.zh: 滿半歲周，去之，為入縮歷；

translations.literal: When full of half a tropical year circumference, remove it; this is entry into the deficiency sequence;
translations.idiomatic: When it fills half a tropical year, discard that amount; the planet is on the deficiency arc;

sentences.zh: 各在初限已下，為初限；

translations.literal: In each, if at or below the initial limit, this is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: If the position is at or below the initial limit, it falls within the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，反減半歲周，余為末限；

translations.literal: If above, in turn subtract half a tropical year circumference; the remainder is the final limit;
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract half a tropical year; the remainder gives the position within the final limit;

sentences.zh: 即得五星平合見伏入盈縮歷日及分秒。

translations.literal: One then obtains the five planets' mean conjunction, appearance-and-stationary-hidden entry into the excess-deficiency sequence in days and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the days and parts of entry into the excess-deficiency epicycle for each planet's mean conjunction, appearance, and stationary-hidden phases.

sentences.zh: 求五星平合見伏行差

translations.literal: To find the five planets' mean conjunction, appearance-and-stationary-hidden motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the relative motion for each planet's mean conjunction, appearance, and stationary-hidden phases.

sentences.zh: 各以其星其段初日星行分，與其段初日太陽行分相減，余為行差。

translations.literal: For each, subtract that planet's phase first-day solar motion parts from that planet's phase first-day planetary motion parts; the remainder is the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet and phase, subtract the Sun's first-day motion rate from the planet's first-day motion rate; the remainder is the relative motion.

sentences.zh: 若金、水二星退行在退合者，以其段初日星行分，並其段初日太陽行分，為行差；

translations.literal: If Venus and Mercury are in retrograde at retrograde conjunction, add that phase's first-day planetary motion parts and first-day solar motion parts; this is the motion difference;
translations.idiomatic: If Venus or Mercury is retrograde at retrograde conjunction, add the planet's first-day motion rate to the Sun's first-day motion rate to obtain the relative motion;

sentences.zh: 內水星夕伏晨見者，直以其段初日太陽行分為行差。

translations.literal: In the case of Mercury with evening stationary hidden and morning appearance, directly take that phase's first-day solar motion parts as the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury in its evening stationary-hidden, morning-appearance configuration, take the Sun's first-day motion rate directly as the relative motion.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合定見定伏泛積

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction, fixed appearance, fixed stationary hidden provisional accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the provisional true accumulation for fixed conjunction, appearance, and stationary-hidden phases of the five planets.

sentences.zh: 木火土三星，以平合晨見夕伏定積日，便為定合伏見泛積日及分秒。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, take the mean-conjunction morning-appearance evening-stationary-hidden fixed accumulation day directly as the fixed conjunction, stationary hidden, appearance provisional accumulation in days and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, the true accumulation day for mean conjunction with morning appearance and evening stationary hidden serves directly as the provisional true accumulation for conjunction, stationary hidden, and appearance.

sentences.zh: 金水二星，置其段盈縮差度及分秒，

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, set that phase's excess-deficiency difference in degrees and parts and seconds,
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, take the excess-deficiency correction in degrees and parts for that phase,

sentences.zh: （水星倍之。）〉

translations.literal: (For Mercury, double it.)
translations.idiomatic: (Double the value for Mercury.)

sentences.zh: 各以其段行差除之，為日，不滿，退除為分秒。

translations.literal: For each, divide by that phase's motion difference to obtain days; what does not fill, retreat and remove as parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the relative motion for that phase to convert to days, with the remainder as parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 在平合夕見晨伏者，盈減縮加；

translations.literal: For mean conjunction with evening appearance and morning stationary hidden, subtract if in excess and add if in deficiency;
translations.idiomatic: For mean conjunction with evening appearance and morning stationary hidden, subtract when in excess and add when in deficiency;

sentences.zh: 在退合夕伏晨見者，盈加縮減；

translations.literal: For retrograde conjunction with evening stationary hidden and morning appearance, add if in excess and subtract if in deficiency;
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde conjunction with evening stationary hidden and morning appearance, add when in excess and subtract when in deficiency;

sentences.zh: 各以加減定積為定合伏見泛積日及分秒。

translations.literal: In each case add or subtract to the fixed accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction, stationary hidden, appearance provisional accumulation in days and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the correction to the true accumulation to obtain the provisional true accumulation for fixed conjunction, stationary hidden, and appearance in days and parts.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合定積定星

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true accumulation and true longitude for fixed conjunction of the five planets.

sentences.zh: 木火土三星，各以平合行差除其段初日太陽盈縮積，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, divide each phase's first-day solar excess-deficiency accumulation by the mean-conjunction motion difference; this is the days of separation-from-conjunction difference;
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, divide the first-day solar excess-deficiency accumulation by the mean-conjunction relative motion to obtain the days of separation-from-conjunction correction;

sentences.zh: 不滿，退除為分秒，以太陽盈縮積減之，為距合差度。

translations.literal: What does not fill, retreat and remove as parts and seconds; subtract from the solar excess-deficiency accumulation; this is the degrees of separation-from-conjunction difference.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the remainder to parts and seconds, then subtract from the solar excess-deficiency accumulation to obtain the degrees of separation-from-conjunction correction.

sentences.zh: 各置其星定合泛積，以距合差日盈減縮加之，為其星定合定積日及分秒；

translations.literal: For each, set that planet's fixed-conjunction provisional accumulation; with the days of separation-from-conjunction difference subtract if in excess and add if in deficiency; this is that planet's fixed-conjunction fixed accumulation in days and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Take the provisional true accumulation for fixed conjunction and apply the days of separation-from-conjunction correction—subtracting when in excess and adding when in deficiency—to obtain the true accumulation in days and parts;

sentences.zh: 以距合差度盈減縮加之，為其星定合定星度及分秒。

translations.literal: With the degrees of separation-from-conjunction difference subtract if in excess and add if in deficiency; this is that planet's fixed-conjunction fixed star in degrees and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the degrees of separation-from-conjunction correction—subtracting when in excess and adding when in deficiency—to obtain the true longitude at fixed conjunction in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 金水二星，順合退合者，各以平合退合行差，除其日太陽盈縮積，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, whether at direct or retrograde conjunction, divide that day's solar excess-deficiency accumulation by the mean-conjunction or retrograde-conjunction motion difference; this is the days of separation-from-conjunction difference;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury at direct or retrograde conjunction, divide that day's solar excess-deficiency accumulation by the appropriate relative motion to obtain the days of separation-from-conjunction correction;

sentences.zh: 不滿，退除為分秒，順加退減太陽盈縮積，為距合差度。

translations.literal: What does not fill, retreat and remove as parts and seconds; for direct motion add and for retrograde subtract the solar excess-deficiency accumulation; this is the degrees of separation-from-conjunction difference.
translations.idiomatic: Convert the remainder to parts and seconds, then add for direct motion or subtract for retrograde motion from the solar excess-deficiency accumulation to obtain the degrees of separation-from-conjunction correction.

sentences.zh: 順合者，盈加縮減其星定合泛積，為其星定合定積日及分秒；

translations.literal: For direct conjunction, add if in excess and subtract if in deficiency from that planet's fixed-conjunction provisional accumulation; this is that planet's fixed-conjunction fixed accumulation in days and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: For direct conjunction, add when in excess and subtract when in deficiency from the provisional true accumulation to obtain the true accumulation in days and parts;

sentences.zh: 退合者，以距合差日盈減縮加、距合差度盈加縮減其星退定合泛積，為其星退定合定積日及分秒；

translations.literal: For retrograde conjunction, with the days of separation-from-conjunction difference subtract if in excess and add if in deficiency, and with the degrees subtract if in excess and add if in deficiency from that planet's retrograde fixed-conjunction provisional accumulation; this is that planet's retrograde fixed-conjunction fixed accumulation in days and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde conjunction, apply the days correction by subtracting when in excess and adding when in deficiency, and the degrees correction by adding when in excess and subtracting when in deficiency, to the provisional retrograde true accumulation to obtain the true accumulation in days and parts;

sentences.zh: 命之，為退定合定星度及分秒。

translations.literal: Name it; this is the retrograde fixed-conjunction fixed star in degrees and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Assign the lodge position to obtain the true longitude at retrograde fixed conjunction in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至日及分秒，加其星定合定積日及分秒，滿旬周，去之，命甲子算外，即得定合日辰及分秒。

translations.literal: Add the Heavenly Standard winter solstice day and parts and seconds to that planet's fixed-conjunction fixed accumulation in days and parts and seconds; when full of the ten-day cycle remove it; name outside the jiazi count; one then obtains the fixed-conjunction day, double-hour, and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add the Heavenly Standard winter solstice date and time to the true accumulation for fixed conjunction, reduce modulo the ten-day cycle, and assign the day and double-hour from the sexagenary cycle to obtain the calendar date and time of fixed conjunction.

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至加時黃道日度及分秒，加其星定合定星度及分秒，滿黃道宿次，去之，即得定合所躔黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add the Heavenly Standard winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at the hour of occurrence and parts and seconds to that planet's fixed-conjunction fixed star in degrees and parts and seconds; when full of an ecliptic lodge span remove it; one then obtains the ecliptic lodge-degree and parts and seconds where the fixed conjunction is located.
translations.idiomatic: Add the Heavenly Standard winter solstice ecliptic longitude at the hour of occurrence to the true longitude at fixed conjunction, reducing modulo one lodge span, to obtain the ecliptic lodge-degree and parts where the fixed conjunction occurs.

sentences.zh: （徑求五星合伏定日：木、火、土三星，以夜半黃道日度，減其星夜半黃道宿次，余在其日太陽行分已下，為其日伏合；

translations.literal: (To find directly the five planets' fixed days of conjunction and stationary hidden: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, subtract that planet's midnight ecliptic lodge position from the midnight ecliptic solar degree; if the remainder is at or below that day's solar motion parts, that day is stationary hidden and conjunction;
translations.idiomatic: (To determine fixed conjunction and stationary-hidden days directly: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, subtract the planet's midnight ecliptic lodge position from the midnight ecliptic solar longitude; if the remainder is at or below the Sun's daily motion, that day is the stationary-hidden conjunction;

sentences.zh: 金、水二星，以其星夜半黃道宿次，減夜半黃道日度，余在其日金、水二星行分已下者，為其日伏合。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, subtract the midnight ecliptic solar degree from that planet's midnight ecliptic lodge position; if the remainder is at or below that day's Venus or Mercury motion parts, that day is stationary hidden and conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, subtract the midnight ecliptic solar longitude from the planet's midnight ecliptic lodge position; if the remainder is at or below the planet's daily motion, that day is the stationary-hidden conjunction.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星伏退合者，視其日太陽夜半黃道宿次，未行到金、水二星宿次，又視次日太陽行過金、水二星宿次，金、水二星退行過太陽宿次，為其日定合伏退定日。）〉

translations.literal: (For Venus and Mercury in stationary hidden and retrograde conjunction, observe that day's midnight solar ecliptic lodge position has not yet reached the Venus or Mercury lodge position; then observe the next day the Sun passes the Venus or Mercury lodge position and Venus or Mercury in retrograde passes the solar lodge position; that day is the fixed conjunction, stationary hidden, retrograde fixed day.)
translations.idiomatic: (For Venus and Mercury in stationary-hidden retrograde conjunction, check whether at midnight the Sun's ecliptic lodge position has not yet reached the planet's lodge position; then on the next day, when the Sun passes the planet's lodge position and the planet in retrograde passes the Sun's lodge position, that day is the fixed retrograde conjunction and stationary-hidden date.)

sentences.zh: 求木火土三星定見伏定積日

translations.literal: To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn fixed appearance and stationary hidden fixed accumulation days.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true accumulation for fixed appearance and stationary hidden of Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn.

sentences.zh: 各置其星定見定伏泛積日及分秒，晨加夕減九十一日三十一分六秒，如在半歲周已下，自相乘，已上，反減歲周，余亦自相乘，滿七十五，除之為分，滿百為度，不滿，退除為秒；

translations.literal: For each, set that planet's fixed appearance and stationary hidden provisional accumulation in days and parts and seconds; for morning appearance add and for evening stationary hidden subtract ninety-one days, thirty-one parts, six seconds; if at or below half a tropical year circumference, square it; if above, in turn subtract the tropical year circumference and square the remainder; when full of seventy-five divide to obtain parts, when full of one hundred to obtain degrees; what does not fill, retreat and remove as seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Take the provisional true accumulation for fixed appearance and stationary hidden; add ninety-one days 31 parts 6 seconds for morning appearance and subtract for evening stationary hidden; if at or below half a tropical year, square the value, otherwise subtract the tropical year and square the remainder; divide by seventy-five for parts and by one hundred for degrees, with the remainder as seconds;

sentences.zh: 以其星見伏度乘之，一十五除之；

translations.literal: Multiply by that planet's appearance-and-stationary-hidden degree and divide by fifteen;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the planet's appearance-and-stationary-hidden arc and divide by fifteen;

sentences.zh: 所得，以其段行差除之，為日，不滿，退除為分秒；

translations.literal: Divide what is obtained by that phase's motion difference to obtain days; what does not fill, retreat and remove as parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Divide the result by the relative motion for that phase to convert to days, with the remainder as parts and seconds;

sentences.zh: 見加伏減泛積，為其星定見伏定積日及分秒；

translations.literal: For appearance add and for stationary hidden subtract from the provisional accumulation; this is that planet's fixed appearance and stationary hidden fixed accumulation in days and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Add for appearance and subtract for stationary hidden from the provisional accumulation to obtain the true accumulation for fixed appearance and stationary hidden in days and parts;

sentences.zh: 加命如前，即得定見定伏日辰及分秒。

translations.literal: Add and name as before; one then obtains the fixed appearance and stationary hidden day, double-hour, and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add and assign the day and hour as before to obtain the calendar date and time of fixed appearance and stationary hidden.

sentences.zh: 求金水二星定見伏定積日

translations.literal: To find Venus and Mercury fixed appearance and stationary hidden fixed accumulation days.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true accumulation for fixed appearance and stationary hidden of Venus and Mercury.

sentences.zh: 各以伏見日行差，除其段初日太陽盈縮積，為日，不滿，退除為分秒；

translations.literal: For each, divide that phase's first-day solar excess-deficiency accumulation by the stationary-hidden-and-appearance daily motion difference to obtain days; what does not fill, retreat and remove as parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: For each phase, divide the first-day solar excess-deficiency accumulation by the daily relative motion for stationary hidden and appearance to obtain days, with the remainder as parts and seconds;

sentences.zh: 若夕見晨伏，盈加縮減；

translations.literal: If evening appearance and morning stationary hidden, add if in excess and subtract if in deficiency;
translations.idiomatic: For evening appearance and morning stationary hidden, add when in excess and subtract when in deficiency;

sentences.zh: 如晨見夕伏，盈減縮加；

translations.literal: If morning appearance and evening stationary hidden, subtract if in excess and add if in deficiency;
translations.idiomatic: For morning appearance and evening stationary hidden, subtract when in excess and add when in deficiency;

sentences.zh: 以加減其星定見定伏泛積日及分秒，為常積。

translations.literal: Add or subtract to that planet's fixed appearance and stationary hidden provisional accumulation in days and parts and seconds; this is the regular accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the correction to the provisional true accumulation for fixed appearance and stationary hidden to obtain the regular accumulation.

sentences.zh: 如在半歲周已下，為冬至後；

translations.literal: If at or below half a tropical year circumference, this is after the winter solstice;
translations.idiomatic: If at or below half a tropical year, the date falls after the winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 已上，去之，余為夏至後。

translations.literal: If above, remove it; the remainder is after the summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract half a tropical year; the remainder falls after the summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 各在九十一日三十一分六秒已下，自相乘，已上，反減半歲周，亦自相乘。

translations.literal: In each, if at or below ninety-one days, thirty-one parts, six seconds, square it; if above, in turn subtract half a tropical year circumference and likewise square it.
translations.idiomatic: If the value is at or below ninety-one days 31 parts 6 seconds, square it; if above, subtract half a tropical year and square the remainder.

sentences.zh: 冬至後晨，夏至後夕，一十八而一，為分；

translations.literal: After the winter solstice in the morning and after the summer solstice in the evening, divide by eighteen; this is parts;
translations.idiomatic: For morning appearances after the winter solstice and evening appearances after the summer solstice, divide by eighteen to obtain parts;

sentences.zh: 冬至後夕，夏至後晨，七十五而一，為分；

translations.literal: After the winter solstice in the evening and after the summer solstice in the morning, divide by seventy-five; this is parts;
translations.idiomatic: For evening appearances after the winter solstice and morning appearances after the summer solstice, divide by seventy-five to obtain parts;

sentences.zh: 又以其星見伏度乘之，一十五除之；

translations.literal: Again multiply by that planet's appearance-and-stationary-hidden degree and divide by fifteen;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply again by the planet's appearance-and-stationary-hidden arc and divide by fifteen;

sentences.zh: 所得，滿行差，除之，為日，不滿，退除為分秒，加減常積，為定積。

translations.literal: When what is obtained is full of the motion difference, divide to obtain days; what does not fill, retreat and remove as parts and seconds; add or subtract to the regular accumulation; this is the fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the result by the relative motion to convert to days, with the remainder as parts and seconds, then add or subtract from the regular accumulation to obtain the true accumulation.

sentences.zh: 在晨見夕伏者，冬至後加之，夏至後減之；

translations.literal: For morning appearance and evening stationary hidden, add after the winter solstice and subtract after the summer solstice;
translations.idiomatic: For morning appearance and evening stationary hidden, add the correction after the winter solstice and subtract after the summer solstice;

sentences.zh: 夕見晨伏者，冬至後減之，夏至後加之；

translations.literal: For evening appearance and morning stationary hidden, subtract after the winter solstice and add after the summer solstice;
translations.idiomatic: For evening appearance and morning stationary hidden, apply the correction by subtracting after the winter solstice and adding after the summer solstice;

sentences.zh: 為其星定見定伏定積日及分秒；

translations.literal: this is that planet's fixed appearance and stationary hidden fixed accumulation in days and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: this gives the true accumulation in days and parts for fixed appearance and stationary hidden;

sentences.zh: 加命如前，即得定見定伏日晨及分秒。

translations.literal: Add and name as before; one then obtains the fixed appearance and stationary hidden day, double-hour, and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add and assign the day and hour as before to obtain the calendar date and time of fixed appearance and stationary hidden.
